warnings.headline: Yellow Wind Eastern Västernorrland County
warnings.description:
During Sunday, windy weather with very strong gusts.; What happens?: On Sunday, southeast winds will increase as a large area of low pressure moves in over Sweden. We expect wind speeds of 20 to 25 meters per second in the gusts.; What should I think about?: Roads may be blocked by fallen trees or branches.
There is a risk of delays or cancelled departures in public transport.
Anchor and secure loose objects, such as trampolines and garden furniture. Be aware that temporary structures such as scaffolding also can blow away.
Risk of damage to forest, for example in felling edges and newly thinned forest.

warnings.headline: Yellow Near gale 14-17 m/s Northern Sea of Bothnia
warnings.description:
Night to Sunday southeast 14-17 m/s.; What should I think about?: Pay close attention to the marine forecast and prepare crew and vessel for high winds and seas.
Keep in mind that the wind gusts are often significantly higher than the average wind.; Where?: Northern Sea of Bothnia
